name: Jellyseerr Requests
author: claymaver
description: Jellyseerr inside Jellyfin: a Home-screen tab with Discover, Movies/TV genre browsing, Upcoming, rich detail view (cast, trailer, play), per-user requests, approve/decline for managers, and issue reporting. API is gated by your Jellyfin login.

vars.name: Jellyseerr URL
vars.description: Base URL of your Jellyseerr instance, e.g. https://jellyseerr.example.com

vars.name: Jellyseerr API Key
vars.description: Found in Jellyseerr under Settings -> General -> API Key. Stays server-side, never sent to the browser.

vars.name: Jellyfin URL (internal)
vars.description: Address this server can reach Jellyfin at, used to verify visitors' login tokens. Usually http://localhost:8096

vars.name: Notify when requests are available (optional)
vars.description: Shows a Jellyfin pop-up message to the requester (on any open session) when Jellyseerr reports their request is available. Needs the Jellyseerr webhook set up (see README). Only reaches people with Jellyfin open.

vars.name: Webhook Secret (optional)
vars.description: Only used for notifications. Put the same value in Jellyseerr's webhook 'Authorization Header' field. Leave blank to disable.
